# Serakki

> Serakki is an offline game of unlikely combinations, with one rich world, DLC and a World Editor. Start with the free Serakki Mini.

This file indexes the website's native Markdown references. The full game is in development. Desktop Editor MCP capabilities are separate from the browser previews.

## Product

- [Serakki homepage reference](https://serakki.dev/index.md): The full game, the original Serakki world, DLC, the Editor, Mini, community worlds, MCP and desktop downloads.

## Downloads

By downloading Serakki Mini, you agree to the license. Read it before downloading. [License · 2026-10-04](https://serakki.dev/license/index.md).

- [Serakki Mini for Windows](https://github.com/marek-hanzal/serakki-game/releases/latest/download/serakki-mini-windows-x64.exe): EXE installer.
- [Serakki Mini for Mac](https://github.com/marek-hanzal/serakki-game/releases/latest/download/serakki-mini-macos-arm64.dmg): DMG · Apple Silicon.
- [Serakki Mini for Linux](https://github.com/marek-hanzal/serakki-game/releases/latest/download/serakki-mini-linux-x64.AppImage): AppImage.
